Package io.mavlink4j.service

Class CommandService

java.lang.Object
io.mavlink4j.service.CommandService
public final class CommandService extends Object
MAVLink's command microservice (command protocol): COMMAND_LONG and COMMAND_INT, awaited as COMMAND_ACK matched on (origin sysid, command id) only. Built on RequestResponse — the retry/extension mechanics live there; this class only supplies Command's own policy: how to build the two payload shapes, how a COMMAND_ACK maps to a verdict, and how a MAV_RESULT maps to an outcome.

confirmation vs. IN_PROGRESS

A silent retry (no reply of any kind within timeout) resends with confirmation incremented — the vehicle's own way of telling a retransmit from a fresh command. A reply of MAV_RESULT_IN_PROGRESS is not silence: it is data, so it never triggers a resend — it only extends how long we keep waiting for a truly terminal result, capped at MavlinkSettings.commandMaxInProgressExtensions() extensions so a vehicle that reports progress forever cannot wedge a caller's future indefinitely. If that cap is reached, the exchange still completes — with CommandResult.Status.IN_PROGRESS rather than silently hanging or reporting a bare timeout.

COMMAND_INT has no confirmation field

The spec gives COMMAND_INT no retry-counter field at all — send(io.mavlink4j.PeerId, io.mavlink4j.service.Command)'s payload builder for a Command.Positioned ignores the attempt number it is handed (accepted, not a bug).

  • Method Details

    • send

      public CompletableFuture<CommandResult> send(PeerId target, Command command)
      Sends command to target — a COMMAND_LONG or a COMMAND_INT depending on how it was built — and awaits its COMMAND_ACK. Never throws for a protocol-level outcome (denial, timeout, ...) — those are values in the returned CommandResult; the returned future fails only for a send-level fault (e.g. the target has never been heard from — see RoutingFrameSink).

      COMMAND_INT carries no confirmation field (the spec's own field list for this message has none), so a retry of a Command.Positioned resends byte-identical params — there is nothing else for the vehicle to key a retry-vs-fresh distinction on.
